name: Batch 03 · Hooks after dark
status: Prepared as 25 unreviewed candidates; host votes live separately
selection_method: Based on Batch 02: 12 keeps and 13 cuts. 18 new lead artists, seven winner follow-ups, no repeated lead artist or album; more vocal hooks and dark electro, less garage. Editorial suitability hypotheses, not independently auditioned audio.
